original_forecast.resolution_rule: Probability Friday close exceeds 7,757.64; CPI/PPI/retail-sales week creates two-sided tail risk. Use official/index-provider or major financial-data close, consistently.
rationale: Record-high momentum and strong technology leadership support the upside base rate.
Payroll contraction and major inflation releases create near-term downside/event risk.
High nominal yields constrain valuation expansion.
surprising_if: Credit spreads widen sharply while SPX remains persistently at new highs.

resolution.source: Associated Press, 2026-08-14 U.S. market close: S&P 500 closed at 7,785.76, up 28.12 points for the week.
resolution.audit_note: Forecast content above is preserved verbatim. The weekly up-event resolved true, the point estimate missed by 10.76 points, and the 80% interval covered. The point forecast beat its precommitted no-change benchmark. The outcome was scored before post-Aug. 12 evidence was used to revise the model.
